description: Victoria road crash data and Road Crash Information System is a group of 2 related entries of the DITRDCSA Data Catalogue, listed under the Road Safety Data (National Road Safety Hub) group and published by Department of Transport and Planning, VIC; VicRoads. Members: Victoria Road Crash Data; Victoria Road Crash Information System. Example entry: This data has been consolidated from Victoria Police reports and hospital injury information, validated and enriched to provide a detailed view of road crashes and injuries across Victoria. The data provides users with information about Victorian fatal and injury road crash data based on time, location, conditions, crash type, road user type, and other relevant attributes. Coverage is Victoria, 1987 onward; spatial detail follows the source and is not stated in the entry. The catalogue lists the update frequency as monthly, the status as current, and the entry was last changed on 2025-02-24. Files and pages listed: HTML (2 resources), reached from the source page and the catalogue entry, with the CKAN API giving the metadata. Access is restricted or conditional according to the catalogue; the licence is CC-BY (version not stated); other members not stated. Caveats: the record was written from the catalogue metadata only, so the source page was not opened, the file contents were not checked, and many entries are HTML landing pages or PDF reports, not data files. It can support road incident and emergency response analysis and capacity and investment planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-catalogue-australia.
